1: A Christian does not need the absence of fear to stand his ground.
2: Strength is not never falling; it is refusing to remain on the ground.
3: The man who governs himself is harder to conquer than the man who governs others.
4: God did not give you strength so you could surrender it to every temptation.
5: Weak moments do not excuse weak decisions.
6: Faith is proven when obedience becomes expensive.
7: A disciplined Christian does not ask his feelings for permission to obey God.
8: The storm does not decide whether you stand. Your foundation does.
9: Courage is obedience while fear is still speaking.
10: The Christian who cannot say no to himself will eventually say no to God.
11: Pressure does not create conviction; it reveals whether you had any.
12: You were not called to be comfortable. You were called to be faithful.
13: Carry the cross. Comfort was never the command.
14: A hard road is not evidence that God has abandoned you.
15: Stand until standing becomes your testimony.
16: Temptation is not your master simply because it is loud.
17: Your flesh may demand surrender. It does not get the final vote.
18: A Christian's strength is measured by what he refuses to become under pressure.
19: Do not pray for an easier battle while refusing to become a stronger soldier.
20: The world can exhaust your body without conquering your faith.
